changelog: NEW Plugin Health Scanner & Auto-Repair inside the TV Panel: scans ALL installed plugins, reports Broken / Stopped (with exact cause) / Healthy status, and auto-repairs missing files, missing Python modules, permissions, stale bytecode, or broken installs in one click
NEW XCplugin IPTV (XCPlugin Forever v5.2) + 7 XtraEvent editions (v6.890 All-Python, v6.840 Py3, v6.7 ElieSat, v6.6 Stable, v5.3 Light, v4.6 Py2/Py3, Mod by M.Nasr & v4.2 Classic)

Reorganized categories: EPGImport, EPGTranslator, SubSupport, SubSupport Pro & Translate AI moved to Subtitles & EPG Packs; Fury-FHD Setup moved to FullHD & 4K Skins; Screen Grab, ScreenGrabber & ShootYourScreen moved to Plugins Hub
Includes ALL v5.4.0 A-Z sorting, CCcam/OSCam Adders, Free Servers, Live Image Browser, MultiBoot, Channels, Bootlogos & Backup/Restore Manager
